== Towers ==
I welcome help in creating the new pages for new characters and places named in the prologue.
I'm considering that we should create a page named "Watchtower" or "Tower Chain" for the chain of watch towers bordering the Blight to defend against the attack from the Blight. Such a page would more easily and efficiently redirect searches for all the towers along the Blight border. I don't see a need for each individual tower to have a dedicated stub of a page. What do you think? [[User:Ronmamita|Ronmamita]] 21:20, September 30, 2010 (UTC)
:Heeth Tower should remain as a separate page, as there is sufficient information on it. As for Rena and Farmay Towers, I'm not sure yet. There should definitely be a page on the Blightwatch. For now, I would suggest that we wait and see if the rest of ToM gives us any more information on the towers. However, even if no new information is given on the towers, it wouldn't be [[Stedding Jentoine|without precedent]] to create short pages on things with very little information. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 23:07, September 30, 2010 (UTC)
